title: Mysterious Glowing UFO Sightings Over Atlantic and California Baffle Experts
description: A recent sighting by sailors in the Atlantic and a previous video of a UFO over California have left experts baffled. The sightings describe glowing orbs moving at impossible speeds and patterns, but the radar shows nothing. The National UFO Reporting Center has investigated the sightings, but no explanation has been found.
